messages:
ellie_cs: Fairwater ops here — heads up: they're onboarding 3 new localization teams (EU + APAC) plus an Insights squad. We're seeing an uptick in embeddings + realtime summarization traffic. They want guidance on avoiding latency regressions and whether we should move them to a Dedicated pilot / VPC. Estimated traffic: ~3k qps/day, peak realtime ~15 req/s, embeddings batch ~200/s. Any immediate blockers?
jmiller_se: quick Qs — which models are they planning to serve and are they on our SDK/HTTP API? also do they have a preferred region mapping?
ellie_cs: Models: community chat -> open-llama-7b (chat), embeddings -> a smaller embed model (customer calls it embed-lite). They're on our SDK via server-side calls. EU teams will be in eu-west, APAC in asia-southeast. They need ~<200ms p50 for chat.
priya_eng: For sub-200ms p50 we usually recommend Dedicated with regional routing + prefix/KV caching. Suggest starting pilot with 2 pods per region (canary scaling to 4) and quantized model variants (q4f16) for embeddings. Also enable continuous batching for nightly bulk embed jobs. Example config snippet to share with them:
```yaml
routing:
  - region: eu-west1
    pool: dedicated-eu-1
  - region: asia-southeast1
    pool: dedicated-apac-1
performance:
  min_pods: 2
  max_pods: 4
  batching: auto
  kv_cache: enabled
```
jmiller_se: I'll spin up the pilot ticket and propose a canary rollout + 24h stress window to validate latency. Need their sample traffic and model artifacts. Also check if they want private (VPC) or just Dedicated in our hosted network.
ryan_am: FYI this account hits renewal in ~60 days. This is a clear expansion/upsell motion. Recommend we bundle 3-month committed Dedicated at a promotional rate to lock adoption. I'll coordinate commercial terms after SRE validation.
ops_bot: Pilot ticket created: PILOT-7123 — assigned to jmiller_se. Onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-onboard (internal).
ellie_cs: Thanks — I'll book a kickoff Tue 11:00 PT and ask them to upload sample traffic (1 full day + a 10min realtime traffic trace). @jmiller_se can you post the preflight checklist in the thread? :thumbsup:
jmiller_se: on it, will post checklist today. Also asking infra to pre-allocate two GPU nodes in eu-west1 and apac-1 for the canary.
priya_eng: Preflight checklist (short):
- model artifacts accessible (s3 or signed URL)
- sample realtime trace + batch windows
- expected qps/time-of-day map
- network ACLs and allowed egress to our collector endpoints
- KMS access if they require key-managed models
Link to full checklist: /internal/playbooks/dedicated-preflight
ellie_cs: Perfect. I'll capture the Qs in the kickoff agenda and surface any renewal impact to finance. If latency holds after canary we push for Dedicated commit.
ryan_am: I'll prepare a 3-month promo offer and attach to the pilot ticket. If they agree, we should engage Solutions Engineers for a post-pilot health review.
ellie_cs: Great — thanks all. I'll update PILOT-7123 after kickoff. :rocket:
